notes: Silent English-captioned desktop simulation mapping Mini-IPHOREOS's existing toy-scale results onto the EIC grant's own O1-O4 objective language (EIC_Objectives_Methodology/IPHOREOS_Section_1_3_Objectives_and_Methodology_Final3.docx). This does not claim the toy wall-approach robot satisfies O1-O4 at TRL4 scale; every chapter states its scope limit on screen. Revised from the first cut so each objective has its own large, distinct visual (replication bars / context meter / scoreboard / rejection alert) and colour badge, not a reused generic panel. The O3 chapter uses seed 10000 (deployment_factor~0.808), the case closest to the published paired-mean effect, not a cherry-picked best case. No physical robot data or hardware validation is presented.
